rows.notes: The paper is a system design/proposal (Raspberry Pi, soil moisture and temperature sensors, Android app) describing architecture, modules and an algorithm. The 'Result and Discussion' section only lists system modules; no measurements, trials, surveys, water-use data or model runs are reported. Water saving and addressing water scarcity are asserted in the abstract and conclusion as expected benefits, not demonstrated. Even if treated as primary (a built prototype), it reports no result of its own on water scarcity or any effect, so Q2 would still be no.
